Meta.title: Tepati
Meta.description: Keep your study promises. Two friends, one agreement, one coin ledger.

Auth.loginLead: Pick up your study promise where you left it.
Auth.registerLead: One account for all your study promises.
Auth.nameHint: Also the name you type when you sign a pact.

Auth.passwordLong: Password can be at most 128 characters.

Today.title: Today
Today.empty: No active pact yet. A pact you create or accept will show up here.
Today.allDone: Every check-in for today is taken care of.
Today.nothingDue: Nothing is due today in this pact.
Today.restTitle: Take today as a rest day?
Today.restBody: Today does not count and carries no penalty. Your rest days go from {left} to {after}. This cannot be undone.
Today.waitingReview: Waiting for {partner} to review. If it is not reviewed before {until}, the proof is approved automatically.
Today.autoApproved: Approved automatically because no decision came in time.
Today.missed: Missed. The penalty is recorded in the coin book.
Today.rested: Rest day: today does not count.

Terms.period: This pact runs {days} days, from {start} to {end} (time zone {tz}).
Terms.backerNoCommitment: {name} has no daily check-in. Their part is to fund the pot and review proof.
Terms.cutoff: Proof is due before {time} ({tz}) on scheduled days. After that there is a {grace}-minute grace period.
Terms.cutoffNoGrace: Proof is due before {time} ({tz}) on scheduled days, with no grace period.
Terms.evidenceBoth: {name}'s proof needs at least {files} attachments and {words} words.
Terms.pot: The pot starts at {coins} coins ({idr}) and never drops below {floor} coins.
Terms.doerMiss: If {name} misses 1 day, the pot goes down by {coins} coins ({idr}).
Terms.backerMiss: If {name} misses 1 day, the pot goes up by {coins} coins ({idr}), until it reaches {cap} coins.
Terms.backerMissNoCap: If {name} misses 1 day, the pot goes up by {coins} coins ({idr}), with no upper limit.
Terms.rest: {name} may take {n} rest days with no penalty.
Terms.reviewOneWay: {backer} reviews {doer}'s proof within {hours} hours. If that passes, the proof is approved automatically.
Terms.reviewBoth: You review each other: {backer} reviews {doer}'s proof and the other way round, each within {hours} hours. If that passes, the proof is approved automatically.
Terms.dispute: A rejected proof can be disputed within {hours} hours, and a dispute must be decided within {resolution} hours.
Terms.override: {backer} can cancel an automatic approval of {doer}'s proof within {hours} hours, at most {max} times, with a written reason. {doer} cannot dispute a cancellation. Every cancellation is recorded and visible to both of you.
Terms.overrideOff: {backer} has no power to cancel automatic approvals in this pact.
Terms.iou: Coins are only an IOU between you two. No real money moves through Tepati.

Wizard.fixFirst: Some fields need fixing. We took you to that step.
Wizard.titleHint: Example: UTBK practice questions in November
Wizard.descriptionHint: The goal, or anything else you both should know.
Wizard.timezoneHint: Dates and cutoffs are counted in this zone.
Wizard.backerCommitsLabel: The backer also checks in every day
Wizard.backerCommitsHint: If the backer misses a day, the pot grows. The doer reviews their proof.
Wizard.commitmentHint_backer: Example: Study Calculus for at least 2 hours
Wizard.restDaysHint: Days off that can be declared with no penalty.
Wizard.potHint: What the doer is owed if no day is missed.
Wizard.cutoffHint: Time in the pact's time zone.
Wizard.graceHint: Extra time after the cutoff, 0 to 180.
Wizard.reviewHint: After this, proof is approved automatically.
Wizard.resolutionHint: From the moment it is raised.
Wizard.overridesHint: 0 turns this power off. Always recorded and visible to both.
Wizard.overrideWindowHint: From the moment proof is auto-approved.
Wizard.reviewIntro: These are the terms you will both sign. Read them to the end. Once you have both signed, they cannot be changed.
Wizard.emailHint: We will send the invite link there. Without it, you can copy the link yourself.
Wizard.editWarning: Saving clears both signatures. You will need to sign again.
Wizard.titleLong: The name can be at most 120 characters.
Wizard.descriptionLong: Notes can be at most 1,000 characters.
Wizard.startsPast: A pact can start tomorrow at the earliest, in the pact's time zone.
Wizard.endsBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
Wizard.durationLong: A pact lasts at most 366 days.
Wizard.timezoneInvalid: That time zone is not recognised.
Wizard.commitmentLong: The commitment can be at most 200 characters.
Wizard.scheduleNoDates: None of these days fall between the start and end dates.
Wizard.restDaysInvalid: Use a whole number, 0 or more.
Wizard.attachmentsRange: Use a whole number from 0 to 10.
Wizard.wordsRange: Use a whole number from 0 to 2,000.
Wizard.graceRange: Use a whole number from 0 to 180.
Wizard.potInvalid: Use a whole number, at least 1.
Wizard.potBelowFloor: The starting pot must be above the pot floor.
Wizard.capLow: The ceiling cannot be lower than the starting pot.
Wizard.penaltyInvalid: Use a whole number, at least 1.
Wizard.hoursRange: Use a whole number from 1 to 72.
Wizard.overridesRange: Use a whole number from 0 to 10.

Sign.agreeLabel: I have read the terms above and agree to them.

Invite.title: Pact invitation
Invite.intro: {name} invited you to a study pact. Read the terms, then sign if you agree.
Invite.signIntro: By signing, you join as the doer. The pact is scheduled once you have both signed.
Invite.joinedNotSigned: You have joined, but not signed yet.
Invite.invalidBody: The link has expired, was already used, or the pact has changed. Ask your friend for a new link.
Invite.ownBody: Send the link to your friend. You cannot join your own pact as the doer.
Invite.linkHint: Send it to your friend in a chat. Valid for 7 days.
Invite.proposedBody: Send the link below to your friend. You also need to sign on the pact page.
Invite.proposedEmailed: We sent the invitation to {email}. The link is also below if you want to send it yourself.
Invite.onceNote: This link is shown once. If you lose it, create a new one from the pact page.
Invite.newLinkNote: Older links keep working until they are used or expire.

PactPage.waitingForDoer: Waiting for the doer to join through the invite link.
PactPage.waitingForOther: You have signed. The pact is scheduled as soon as your friend signs too.
PactPage.termsChanged: The terms changed since anyone last signed, so both signatures were cleared. Read them again, then sign.
PactPage.edited: The terms were changed. Both signatures were cleared, so you need to sign again.
PactPage.signIntro: Your signature only covers the terms exactly as written above. If they change, you sign again.
PactPage.scheduled: The pact is scheduled and starts on {date}.
PactPage.laterScreens: The passbook and calendar for a running pact arrive in a later update.
